# Engine plan stage: `--content` plans a spec and tasks, then runs them (tracer) ## What to build A new way to start a run in the engine (`packages/graph-execution`): `graph-execution --content --provider

` starts a run from free markdown. The run's first stage is **planning**: a new agent role `planner` runs in the integration branch's worktree with a prompt made of a headless preamble, the bundled `skills/to-spec/SKILL.md` and `skills/to-tasks/SKILL.md`, and the content. It writes `docs/prd/.md`, `.agents/tasks//*.json` (optionally `test-plan.json`) and a result file `.graph-execution//plan/result.json`. The engine reads the result, loads and validates the planned tasks with the same `loadTasks` + `validateGraph` + `loadTestPlan` as a normal start, commits exactly those files on the integration branch as `Plan: `, writes `specPath`, `tasksDir`, `hashes` and `tasks` into `state.json`, and then either stops at `awaiting-approval` (the default: the plan gate is on, exit code `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL`) or, with `--no-plan-gate`, continues the normal run **in the same process** (same run id, same run page) until `applied`. This slice also adds the three new run statuses (`planning`, `needs-info`, `awaiting-approval`), the optional `plan` object in `state.json`, makes `specPath`/`tasksDir`/`hashes` optional (absent while planning) and fixes every reader of those fields in the engine **and** in `apps/graph-manager`, adds the exit codes `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO` (4) and `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL` (5), a fake-provider planner mode, `--content` support in `--web` (the run page is up during planning, the graph appears once tasks exist) and in graph-manager's `--sandbox` pass-through. Out of scope here (later slices): `--refs` and readiness/needs-info handling, re-running the planner on validation errors (`planAttempts`), `--approve-plan` / `--replan` on resume, and the run page's planning/approval panels. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `docs/prd/automation-api.md` (sections "Decisions" and "Requirements > Engine") — the approved spec this slice implements in part. - `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` (whole file, 458 lines) — options (`buildProgram`, lines 196–280), `runGraph` (lines 125–175), `serveWeb` (lines 177–193), `RunOptions` (lines 32–57). `--content` and `--no-plan-gate` go here. - `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/preflight.ts` (lines 43–58 `checkSpec`, 163–238 `preflight`, 240–288 `preflightResume`) — every pre-run check; add a `plan` kind for `--content`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` (lines 69–100 `RunGraphOptions`, 165–203 `run`, 205–268 `resume`, 270–300 `execute` start, 918–934 `teeOutput`) — `runPlanned` goes next to `run`; `execute` stays private. - `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/startup.ts` (lines 58–98) — `startup()` creates the run id/dir; pass the content file in `references` so it does not trigger the dirty warning. - `packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts` (lines 26–27 `runStatusSchema`, 29–39 `hashesSchema`, 64–91 `stateSchema`, 159–167 `computeHashes`) — schema changes. - `packages/graph-execution/src/state/errors.ts` (whole, 52 lines) — exit codes and `ExitCode` union. - `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts` (whole, 31 lines) — public surface used by graph-manager. - `packages/graph-execution/src/state/paths.ts` (lines 35–51 `RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS`) — `--content` takes a value; `src/cli.test.ts` line 62 checks the list against `--help`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/types.ts` (line 1 `AgentRole`) and `src/providers/fake.ts` (whole, 188 lines) — new role and fake planner mode. - `packages/graph-execution/src/install/skills.ts` (lines 25–26 `SKILLS_SOURCE`) — how the bundled `skills/` folder is found from both `src/` and `dist/`. - `packages/graph-execution/skills/to-spec/SKILL.md`, `skills/to-tasks/SKILL.md`, `skills/to-tasks/validate-tasks.mjs` — the text the planner gets. - `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/references.ts` (whole) — `snapshotReferences` copies spec/tasks into `/context/`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/git/git.ts` (lines 98–124 `dirtyPaths`/`commitLeftovers`/`resetHard`, 187–191 `cleanWorktree`) — git helpers to mirror for the plan commit. - `packages/graph-execution/src/agents/reviewer.ts` (lines 79–84 `fence`), `src/agents/summarizer.ts` (lines 37–63, prompt builder pattern) and `src/review/report.ts` (lines 355–356 path patterns the fake provider parses). - `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/abort.ts` (whole) — `resumeCommand`, `abortRun`. - `packages/graph-execution/src/web/serve.ts` (lines 52–79 `webServeUi`), `src/web/start.ts` (lines 29–78 `startWebUi`), `src/web/server.ts` (lines 19–30 `WebMeta`, 83–117 `WebServerOptions`, 131–215 `createWebServer` store/meta/SSE) — the web page must be up before planning starts and re-attach to the real graph afterwards. - `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/launch.ts` (lines 51–122) and `src/launch/handoff.ts` (line 197: the launcher waits 15 s for the page) — why the page must start before the planner runs. - `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/store.ts` (lines 116–128 `RunStoreOptions`, 348–359 `logFileName`/`writeAgentLogs`), `src/ui/start.tsx` (lines 14–56 `UiOptions`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (lines 165–184 `readState`/`hostState`, 243–260 `summarize`, 338–390 `readTasks`/`buildGraph`, 503–530 `runDetail`) and `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` (lines 107–120 `specTitle`/`suggest`, 195–200) — readers of `specPath`/`tasksDir` that must accept them being absent. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.ts` (lines 19–55 `scanArgs`, 125–165 `POST /api/internal/sandbox-runs`) and `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-paths.ts` (lines 8–10 `PATH_OPTIONS`, 45–74 `toContainerArgs`) — `--sandbox` pass-through from a graph-manager terminal. - Tests to mirror: `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` (lines 1–60 helpers `run`/`withRepo`, 71–90 a full fake run, 598–604 refusing before a run is created), `src/__fixtures__/run-diamond.ts` (in-process run with `createFakeProvider` + `startup`), `src/web-e2e.test.ts` (whole, `--web` detached), `src/e2e.test.ts` (lines 1–76 packed bin), `src/web/server.test.ts` (lines 1–70 `setup`/`openStream`), `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.test.ts` (lines 80–160), `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-paths.test.ts` (lines 76–105). - `TESTING.md` (repo root) — how to try the CLI and the web view with `--provider fake`. ## Patterns to follow **Naming / file conventions:** ``` New engine module: packages/graph-execution/src/plan/ paths.ts – plan file names and path helpers (no I/O except runInputs reading nothing) prompt.ts – plannerPrompt() and the path-line patterns the fake provider parses result.ts – zod schema of plan/result.json stage.ts – planStage(): run the planner once, check its output, commit it Tests next to the code: src/plan/prompt.test.ts, src/plan/stage.test.ts. ESM imports end in ".js". Comments: one short JSDoc line per export, like the rest of src/. ``` **Error handling:** ```typescript // Usage mistakes are UsageError (src/launch/preflight.ts:28) -> exit 2, printed as "error: " by main() in cli.ts. if (opts.runId) throw new UsageError("--run can only be used with --resume"); // A failed step of a run is an AbortRunError subclass (src/state/errors.ts:27) with a step and a resume hint. throw new AbortRunError(message, { step: "planning", hint: resumeCommand(runId) }); // Exit codes are ONLY set in cli.ts through setExitCode (src/e2e.test.ts:151 enforces it): return codes, never process.exit. ``` **Data model / schema pattern (zod v4, `src/state/state.ts`):** ```typescript export const runStatusSchema = z.enum(["running", "applied", "done", "failed", "aborted"]); // add: "planning", "needs-info", "awaiting-approval" specPath: z.string(), // becomes z.string().optional() tasksDir: z.string(), // optional hashes: hashesSchema, // optional ``` **Prompt pattern (`src/agents/summarizer.ts:37-63`, `src/review/report.ts:355-356`):** ```typescript out.push("", summaryPathLine(input.path)); export const SUMMARY_PATH_PATTERN = /Write the JSON summary to this absolute path: `([^`]+)`/; // The fake provider finds the output path in the prompt with the pattern (src/providers/fake.ts:88-94). ``` **Run start pattern (`src/runner/run.ts:165-203`):** acquire the lock, build the `StateStore`, `createBranch` before the first `save()`, `addWorktree` of `/worktrees/integration`, then `execute()`; release the lock in `finally`. **Test pattern:** ```typescript // CLI, out of process (src/cli.test.ts:19-20, 53-60): run the built dist/cli.js in a temp repo const run = (args: string[], cwd = root, env: Record = {}) => execa("node", [cli, ...args], { cwd, env, reject: false }); await withRepo(async (repo) => { const res = await run([...], repo); expect(res.exitCode).toBe(0); }); // In process (src/__fixtures__/run-diamond.ts:35-44): startup({ cwd: repo, provider: "fake", providerInstance: createFakeProvider(), log }) then call the runner. ``` ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/state/errors.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export const EXIT_NEEDS_INFO = 4;` (doc: "The planner found nothing ready to build; the questions are in state.json (`plan.questions`). Final.") and `export const EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL = 5;` (doc: "The plan is committed and waits for approval; resume with `--approve-plan` or `--replan `."). Add both to the `ExitCode` union. `exitCodeFor` stays as is. - **GOTCHA**: 3 is taken by `EXIT_HANDOFF_BLOCKED`. Keep the numbers 4 and 5 (graph-manager and API clients rely on them). - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-execution` ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `runStatusSchema = z.enum(["planning", "needs-info", "awaiting-approval", "running", "applied", "done", "failed", "aborted"])`. - `export const planRefSchema = z.object({ ref: z.string().min(1), url: z.string().optional(), title: z.string().optional() })` and type `PlanRef`. - `export const planStateSchema = z.object({ contentPath: z.string(), refs: z.array(planRefSchema).default([]), gate: z.boolean(), name: z.string().optional(), attempts: z.number().int().min(0).default(0), questions: z.array(z.object({ ref: z.string().optional(), questions: z.array(z.string()) })).default([]), dropped: z.array(z.string()).default([]), feedback: z.array(z.string()).default([]), error: z.string().optional() })`, type `PlanState`. Doc each field: `contentPath` is the run's copy `/plan/content.md`; `gate` true = stop at `awaiting-approval`; `name` is set once planning succeeded; `attempts` planner rounds used; `questions`/`dropped` come from readiness (later slice); `feedback` reject feedback texts (later slice); `error` the last planning error when the run failed in planning. - In `stateSchema`: `specPath: z.string().optional()`, `tasksDir: z.string().optional()`, `hashes: hashesSchema.optional()`, `plan: planStateSchema.optional()`. Doc: "Absent while `status` is `planning` (and in `needs-info`). For a planned run they are the paths the files land on in the repository (`/docs/prd/.md`, `/.agents/tasks/`); until the run is applied the files exist only on the integration branch — read them with `runInputs()` (src/plan/paths.ts)." - **GOTCHA**: Do not add a refinement that rejects missing fields for other statuses: graph-manager parses with `safeParse` and must keep reading old and new files. Missing fields are handled where they are read (next steps). `state.json` written before this change still parses (all new fields optional/defaulted). - **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-execution` (it will now list every reader to fix; fix them in the steps below) ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: export `planRefSchema`, `planStateSchema`, types `PlanRef`, `PlanState` from `./state/state.js`; export `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`, `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL` with the other exit codes (line 27); export `planSpecRel`, `planTasksRel`, `PLAN_DIR` from `./plan/paths.js` (graph-manager needs them to show a planned run's spec and tasks). - **GOTCHA**: never import `cli.ts` here (line 1 comment). ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/paths.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `export const PLAN_DIR = "plan"`; `planDir(runDir) = path.join(runDir, PLAN_DIR)`; `planResultPath(runDir) = path.join(planDir(runDir), "result.json")`; `planContentPath(runDir) = path.join(planDir(runDir), "content.md")`. - `export const PLAN_NAME_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`. - `planSpecRel(name) => \`docs/prd/${name}.md\``, `planTasksRel(name) => \`.agents/tasks/${name}\`` (always `/` separators: they are git paths). - `integrationWorktreeOf(runDir) = path.join(runDir, "worktrees", "integration")`. - `runInputs(state: RunState, runDir: string): { specPath: string; tasksDir: string }` — where the run reads its spec and task folder: for a planned run (`state.plan?.name` set) the integration worktree copies `path.join(integrationWorktreeOf(runDir), ...planSpecRel(name).split("/"))` and the same for the tasks folder; otherwise `state.specPath`/`state.tasksDir`. Throws `Error(\`run ${state.runId} has no spec and tasks yet (status ${state.status})\`)` when they are missing. - **GOTCHA**: The planned files are committed on `graph/`, not in the user's checkout, until the run is applied. Hashes, `snapshotReferences`, the review phase and resume must read the worktree copies; `state.specPath`/`state.tasksDir` hold the repository paths (so graph-manager's spec title and "move spec to done/" in `pr.ts` work after the apply). ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/result.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export const planResultSchema = z.looseObject({ name: z.string().regex(PLAN_NAME_PATTERN, "name must be kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens") })` and `readPlanResult(file): Promise<{ ok: true; result } | { ok: false; error: string }>` — `"the planner wrote no result file at "` when missing, `" is not valid JSON: "`, or `" is invalid: " + z.prettifyError(err)`. - **GOTCHA**: Keep it loose: a later slice replaces it with the full readiness shapes (`{ name, ready: boolean, questions }` and `{ name, ready: string[], notReady }`). Extra keys must not fail now. ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/prompt.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - Export `SKILLS_SOURCE` from `src/install/skills.ts` (it is a private const today at line 26) and import it here; read `to-spec/SKILL.md` and `to-tasks/SKILL.md` with `readFile` in `plannerPrompt` (async), so both `src/` (tests) and `dist/` (packed bin) find them. - `export const PLAN_RESULT_PATH_PATTERN = /Write the JSON result to this absolute path: \`([^\`]+)\`/` and `PLAN_CONTENT_PATH_PATTERN = /The content is in this file: \`([^\`]+)\`/`, with line builders `planResultPathLine(p)` / `planContentPathLine(p)` producing exactly those sentences. - `export interface PlannerPromptInput { content: string; contentPath: string; resultPath: string; taken: string[]; validateScript: string }` and `export async function plannerPrompt(input): Promise` producing, in order: 1. A headless preamble, e.g.: "You are the planner of a graph-execution run. You run unattended: no human will read your questions or answer them. Never ask a question and never wait for approval. Where the skills below say to ask the user, to wait for approval, to commit, to start the run or to open graph-manager, do not: decide yourself and write down what you decided in the spec's Decisions table. Do not implement the change. Do not commit: the engine commits your files. Write only these files: `docs/prd/.md`, the task files in `.agents/tasks//` (and `.agents/tasks//test-plan.json`), and the result file named at the end." 2. `## Skill: to-spec` + the SKILL.md text, then `## Skill: to-tasks` + its text. 3. `## How the skills apply here`: pick one kebab-case `` (pattern above); names already taken (list `input.taken`, or "none"): add `-2`, `-3`… when your name is taken; write the spec to `docs/prd/.md` and the tasks to `.agents/tasks//` relative to your working directory (the run's integration worktree); check the task folder with `node .agents/tasks/` until it prints OK. 4. `## Content` + `planContentPathLine(contentPath)` + `fence(content)` (import `fence` from `../agents/reviewer.js`). 5. `## Result` + "When you are done, write a JSON object `{\"name\": \"\"}`." + `planResultPathLine(resultPath)`. - **PATTERN**: `src/agents/summarizer.ts:37-63` (array of lines joined with "\n"). - **GOTCHA**: The `to-tasks` skill tells the agent to resolve `validate-tasks.mjs` "from the directory this skill was loaded from"; give it the absolute path `path.join(SKILLS_SOURCE, "to-tasks", "validate-tasks.mjs")` instead. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan/prompt.test.ts` (from `packages/graph-execution`) ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/git/git.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export async function commitPaths(worktree: string, base: string, paths: string[], message: string): Promise` — `git reset -q --soft ` (folds any commit the agent made despite the instructions), `git reset -q` (unstage), `git add -f -A -- ` (`-f`: `.agents/` may be gitignored), `git commit -q --no-verify -m `, then `cleanWorktree(worktree)` (drops every other change the agent left), returns the new HEAD. - **PATTERN**: `commitLeftovers` (lines 111–119) and `resetHard` (121–124). - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/git/git.test.ts` ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/stage.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: `export async function planStage(input: { repo: string; runDir: string; worktree: string; provider: Provider; model?: string; signal: AbortSignal; log: (line: string) => void }): Promise<{ ok: true; name: string; commit: string; tasks: Task[] } | { ok: false; error: string }>` — one planner round: 1. `base = await currentHead(worktree)`; `taken` = basenames without `.md` of `docs/prd/*.md` and `docs/prd/done/*.md`, plus folder names in `.agents/tasks/` (read from `worktree`, which is clean at `base`; missing folders = none). 2. `rm(planResultPath(runDir), { force: true })`; read the content from `planContentPath(runDir)`. 3. `provider.run({ role: "planner", label: "plan", prompt, cwd: worktree, signal, model })`; forward `output` events to `log` as `[plan] ` (mirror `runAgent`, run.ts:811-826); exit code ≠ 0 → `{ ok: false, error: "the planner exited with code N" }`; a thrown error → `{ ok: false, error: message }` (but rethrow when `signal.aborted`). 4. Checks, each failure returns `{ ok: false, error }`: `readPlanResult`; name not in `taken` and not present at `base` (`git cat-file -e :` for `planSpecRel(name)`, `docs/prd/done/.md`, `planTasksRel(name)`) → `name is taken: use -2`; the spec file exists and is non-empty (reuse `checkSpec` from `src/launch/preflight.ts`, catch `UsageError` → message); `loadTasks(tasksDir)`, `validateGraph(tasks)`, `loadTestPlan(tasksDir)` (catch `GraphError` → `err.message`). 5. `commit = await commitPaths(worktree, base, [planSpecRel(name), planTasksRel(name)], \`Plan: ${name}\`)`; return `{ ok: true, name, commit, tasks }`. - **GOTCHA**: `test-plan.json` is optional, exactly as on a normal start (`loadTestPlan` returns undefined when missing). The fake planner writes none: with a test plan the fake tester's default report would lack verdicts and fail the review. - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan/stage.test.ts` ### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/types.ts` and `src/providers/fake.ts` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `AgentRole` adds `"planner"`. - Fake planner mode (in `execute`, before the default `files` write): when `opts.role === "planner"`: pick `name` = `fake-plan`, else `fake-plan-2`, `fake-plan-3`… the first whose `docs/prd/.md` is not in `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD` of `opts.cwd`; write `docs/prd/.md` ("# Fake plan\n\n## Problem\n\nPlanned by the fake provider.\n") and `.agents/tasks//1.json` (`{"id":"1","content":"# Write 1.txt\n\nCreate 1.txt.","dependencies":[]}`); then write `attempt.write` files on top (so tests can break the folder); then write the result file at `PLAN_RESULT_PATH_PATTERN.exec(opts.prompt)?.[1]` from a new attempt field `result` (`z.union([z.string(), z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()), z.null()]).optional()`: string as is, object as JSON, `null` nothing, absent `{ "name": , "ready": true, "questions": [] }`); never commit; push `{ type: "exit", code: attempt.exitCode }`. - Export `FAKE_PLAN_NAME = "fake-plan"`. - **PATTERN**: `writeSummary` (fake.ts:88-94) for the path-from-prompt + string/object/null handling; the summarizer special case at line 111. - **GOTCHA**: The default `write` (`
